name: User Sends Unrelated Negative Feedback
goal: Validate bot's ability to redirect when user complains about unrelated company issues.
constraints: Bot should acknowledge feedback but steer conversation back to HR topics.

phases.description: User complains about the cafeteria food quality.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot acknowledges the feedback and gently redirects to HR-related assistance.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
